TeX \mathsfit{g}\bigl\lvert{}^{\Gamma}_{\,\mu}\bigr\rangle = \sum_\nu \bigl\lvert{}^{\Gamma}_{\,\nu}\bigr\rangle\, D^{\Gamma}_{\nu,\mu}(\mathsfit{g});

the matrices of a vector irrep are those of 𝖨\mathsf{I}, on both lifts. Row kk of each table gives DΓ(𝘨)D^{\Gamma}(\mathsfit{g}) of a spinor irrep for the canonical lift 𝘨\mathsfit{g} of even index kk (section 1.3). On the barred partner 𝘨ˉ\bar{\mathsfit{g}} of that lift, a spinor irrep has DΓ(𝘨ˉ)=−DΓ(𝘨)D^{\Gamma}(\bar{\mathsfit{g}}) = -D^{\Gamma}(\mathsfit{g}).

2.3.1 The spinor irreps of dimension 2

  1. The kets (∣ 1 ⁣/21 ⁣/2⟩\bigl\lvert{}^{\nicefrac{1}{2}}_{\,\nicefrac{1}{2}}\bigr\rangle, ∣ −1 ⁣/21 ⁣/2⟩\bigl\lvert{}^{\nicefrac{1}{2}}_{\,-\nicefrac{1}{2}}\bigr\rangle) of D(1 ⁣/2,+1)D^{(\nicefrac{1}{2},+1)} (section 4.3) carry the matrices DE1/2(𝘨)D^{\mathrm{\scriptsize E}_{1/2}}(\mathsfit{g}): Dν,μE1/2(𝘨)D^{\mathrm{\scriptsize E}_{1/2}}_{\nu,\mu}(\mathsfit{g}) is the coefficient of ket ν\nu in 𝘨\mathsfit{g} applied to ket μ\mu.

  2. The matrix DE7/2(𝘨)D^{\mathrm{\scriptsize E}_{7/2}}(\mathsfit{g}) is DE1/2(𝘨)D^{\mathrm{\scriptsize E}_{1/2}}(\mathsfit{g}) with the automorphism ζ20↦ζ2013\zeta_{20} \mapsto \zeta_{20}^{13} applied to every entry. This automorphism sends φ\varphi to 1−φ1 - \varphi and 5\sqrt{5} to −5-\sqrt{5}.
